name: Sense8
description: One gunshot, one death, one moment out of time that irrevocably links eight minds in disparate parts of the world, putting them in each other's lives, each other's secrets, and in terrible danger. Ordinary people suddenly reborn as "Sensates."

videos.title: Limbic Resonance
videos.overview: Eight strangers from cities around the globe begin having experiences that defy explanation.

videos.title: I Am Also a We
videos.overview: Nomi's fortunes take a dark turn, while the rest of the Sensates' connections become stronger and more dangerous.

videos.title: Smart Money Is on the Skinny Bitch
videos.overview: With many of the Sensates' lives becoming more complicated, their newfound gift -- while still a mystery -- proves vital for survival.

videos.title: What's Going On?
videos.overview: Nomi's fate draws nearer, Capheus and Wolfgang's fortunes seem to have turned, but Sun is faced with an impossible choice.

videos.title: Art Is Like Religion
videos.overview: The Sensates struggle with intensifying connections, which results in some interesting days on set for Lito and a wedding day surprise for Kala.

videos.title: Demons
videos.overview: While the Sensates bond, Nomi takes a bold move to gain her freedom and Sun makes a choice she might someday regret.

videos.title: W. W. N. Double D?
videos.overview: Nomi makes a shocking discovery about her former doctor, while Will gets closer to the truth behind his visions and Kala's doubts grow stronger.

videos.title: We Will All Be Judged by the Courage of Our Hearts
videos.overview: Sun fights to adjust to her new life as Capheus tries to change his. Will and Nomi dig up disturbing information that could change everything.

videos.title: Death Doesn't Let You Say Goodbye
videos.overview: Riley learns about her new life and its dangers, Kala deals with the aftermath of the attack on Rajan’s father, and Lito's world spins out of control.

videos.title: What Is Human?
videos.overview: Will learns more about his origins and the threat to his future, while Wolfgang's actions catch up with him, even as his bond with Kala strengthens.

videos.title: Just Turn the Wheel and the Future Changes
videos.overview: Riley's fate draws nearer, while Capheus and Sun are put to the test, and Wolfgang makes his boldest move yet.

videos.title: I Can't Leave Her
videos.overview: In the season finale, with Riley in the hands of Whispers, all of the Sensates' skills are needed to give them any chance at survival.

videos.title: Happy F*cking New Year.
videos.overview: Scandals, surprises and celebrations deepen the Sensates' bond as they work to rebuild their lives and outmaneuver Whispers.

videos.title: Who Am I?
videos.overview: Will and Whispers each race to piece together the other's location, while Lito heads to his first movie premiere since the photos leaked.

videos.title: Obligate Mutualisms
videos.overview: The Sensates make contact with a key figure in BPO. Ripped from her prison cell, Sun sends out a plea for help. Wolfgang meets an intriguing stranger.

videos.title: Polyphony
videos.overview: Kala and Capheus are caught in the middle of angry protests. Lito looks into a journalist's disappearance and uncovers new info on Angelica's cluster.

videos.title: Fear Never Fixed Anything
videos.overview: Bug hits on a solution to Nomi's legal troubles, new cracks begin to appear in Kala's perfect life, and the Sensates consider a bold change of plans.

videos.title: Isolated Above, Connected Below
videos.overview: While Capheus enjoys a welcome surprise, Lito makes a splash at a high-profile event. Riley works to gain the trust of a Sensate she saw at the rave.

videos.title: I Have No Room in My Heart for Hate
videos.overview: Will asks an old friend for help as Riley embarks on a risky journey. Kala makes a troubling discovery. Sun has an intense encounter in the cemetery.

videos.title: All I Want Right Now Is One More Bullet
videos.overview: A familiar face comes back from the dead, a depressed Lito turns to Sun for comfort, and Lila lures Wolfgang into a trap.

videos.title: What Family Actually Means
videos.overview: A family wedding stirs up more trouble for Nomi. Daniela goes all out to land Lito the perfect role. One of the Sensates faces a devastating loss.

videos.title: If All the World's a Stage, Identity Is Nothing But a Costume
videos.overview: Sun moves ahead with her undercover mission, while Lito heads to Hollywood for the audition of a lifetime. Capheus prepares for his first big speech.

videos.title: You Want a War?
videos.overview: At the gala, Sun braces for a showdown with her brother. Soon a dire new threat sends the Sensates scrambling to save another member of the cluster.

videos.title: Amor Vincit Omnia
videos.overview: In the sweeping series finale, passions run high as the Sensates and their closest allies fight to save the cluster and stop their enemies for good.

awards: Nominated for 2 Primetime Emmys. 3 wins & 17 nominations total
